ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)
notes: The Voltage Switch and Tuning loops are host-controlled closed loops with no card-side trim — the host adapts to the card's characteristics rather than configuring the card.
calibration_summary: Two host-side calibration loops: (1) Voltage Switch Sequence at CMD11; (2) UHS-I Tuning Procedure via CMD19. All other electrical parameters (CLK, VDD, signal integrity) are characterized by the host designer but require no closed-loop trim with the card.

tuning_procedure_uhs_i.purpose: Find the optimal CLK sampling phase for high-speed modes (mandatory for SDR104; optional for SDR50 and DDR50).
procedure: Sweep sampling phase (typically 0..360° in N steps; N depends on host PHY).
At each phase, issue CMD19; compare received tuning pattern to expected.
Record pass/fail per phase to build a window map.
Pick the center of the largest contiguous pass window.
tuning_procedure_uhs_i.re_tuning: Re-tuning may be required after temperature drift or after exiting low-power state.

voltage_switch_sequence.purpose: Bring the bus from 3.3 V signaling to 1.8 V signaling for UHS-I modes.
host_actions: After R1, wait for card to drive CMD/DAT0..DAT3 LOW (within Nvs_card_pull_down ≤ 16 CLK).
Verify card releases CMD/DAT0..DAT3 HIGH within 1 ms.
voltage_switch_sequence.error_recovery: If card fails to drive CMD/DAT LOW after CMD11, or fails to release HIGH within 1 ms after CLK restart, host shall power-cycle the card.

vdd_ramp_characterization.purpose: Allow card's internal clock to stabilize before the first command.

no_card_side_trim: SD Card does not expose any analog trim / calibration register on the bus.
